in_english.name: Evaristo
in_english.long_meaning: The name Evaristo originates from the Greek word 'εὐαρίστητος' (Euaristos), meaning 'good', 'well-pleasing', or 'prosperous'. It has its roots in Christian tradition and is associated with Pope Evaristus, who served as the Bishop of Rome from approximately 99 to 107 AD. The name reflects positive attributes valued in Christian culture, such as being well-pleasing to God or exhibiting good character.
